Agent Name: Planner

, Reason for Mistake: The Planner unilaterally redefined “came out” to mean the primary-country wide release per IMDb Release Info and ignored the earlier verified public release of Niyoti on 10 June 2016 (West Bengal) shown by sources. This arbitrary criterion change led to concluding Angali Pangali (17 June 2016) was earlier, contradicting the task’s intended comparison of earliest public release dates, where Niyoti is earlier.
